Evidence: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar radiallahu anhuma sahabi the aur umr me senior the Hasnain Kareemain se, to unhone arz kiya apne abbajaan se. Abdullah bin Umar ko Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath gazwat me talwar chalane ka mauka nahi mila, lekin unka junoon aur talash hamesha thi ki wo Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ho. Unka naam unke father Hazrat Umar ke saath bhi aata hai, jo ke ek mashhoor sahabi the (Source 1, 2).
Justification: Retrieved evidence confirms that Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar was indeed a sahabi and senior in age to Hasnain Kareemain, as stated in Source 1. It also mentions his eagerness to participate in battles under the leadership of Rasulullah ﷺ, aligning with the claim's assertion about his involvement in gazwat. Therefore, the evidence directly supports the claim regarding his status and actions.
